name: OmarKEYS
author: romills
description: OmarKEYS, a Super+K alternative: double-tap Super, hold Super (default 5s), or Super+K to show the live Hyprland keymap as a tree of topic areas and running apps. Type to search, arrows move the highlight and Ctrl+1–9 jump to a group, double-click or Enter runs the highlighted shortcut. Key display, sorting, modifier filters and the opening gestures (Super+K included) are all configurable on the overlay.
